lines.text: His own brothers threw him into a pit and sold him into slavery.
Years in another man's house, then a prison that forgot he even existed.
Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.
Every room they left him in, God was already turning into the room where he would save them.
And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God.
The brothers who sold him wept in his arms. The pit was never the end of the story. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: But God Meant It Unto Good
story: A three-scene illustrated short film on Genesis 50: brothers lowering Joseph into a dusty cistern at dusk, a single figure forgotten in a cold barred cell as the years pass, and two silhouettes folded into one another in warm rose-gold morning light as the brothers who betrayed him are wept over and forgiven.
